topics.title: Standard vs extended ACLs and ACL number ranges
paraphrases: What standard and extended ACLs match on, which number ranges identify them, and what a permit entry allows.

topics.title: ACL processing order, first match and implicit deny

topics.title: Reflexive, time-based and IPv6 ACLs
